# E0416: a drop has a lacuna that is not its one DroppedField refinement

A drop derives a DroppedField lacuna of its own; a DroppedField lacuna written
on the drop refines that one's message, so there is at most one.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	a: string
	b: int
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	a: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		b: drop
	}
	lacunas: {
		b: [{
			type:    DroppedField
			message: "b is gone"
		}, {
			type:    DroppedField
			message: "b is really gone"
		}]
	}
}

BackwardLens: {
	v1_0: _
	v0_0: {
		b: 0
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0416]: lacunas.b: a drop has one DroppedField lacuna, which refines the one it derives
  --> 1.0.thema:14:6
   |
14 |         }, {
   |            ^
   |
```
